title: Chat with a document
description: Split pasted document text into passages, rank them against your question with BM25 keyword scoring, and quote the best passages with the score that found them. Retrieval is deterministic: you can see why a passage was chosen, and the answer is quoted rather than generated.
x-privacyfold-engine: none (plain JavaScript in the browser tab)

input.description: Text to process. Sent to the tool only through the URL fragment / local input.
